event.title: Traders raise odds of 50 bps Fed rate hike as CPI rise exceeds expectations
event.description: New data has revealed that US consumer prices rose faster than anticipated, prompting speculation about interest rate changes. Fed Governor Christopher Waller suggested a half percentage point hike may be necessary if core prices continue rising. The Consumer Price Index showed a month-over-month increase of 0.4% in October, with core inflation remaining persistent. The bond market reacted strongly to these developments, significantly affecting Treasury yields.

event.title: US stocks: Dow Jones falls 200 points as hot inflation revives rate-hike fears; Nvidia sinks
event.description: On Tuesday, Wall Street faced a downturn as inflation figures surpassed projections, raising worries about potential interest rate hikes. The declines were evident across the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite indices. While financial stocks showed minor gains, technology shares, especially Nvidia, experienced fluctuations due to uncertainty in leadership. Anthropic's looming IPO threatens to heat up competition in the AI field.

event.title: Anthropic's potential mega IPO joins ranks of world's biggest stock market listings
event.description: Anthropic has kicked off its U.S. IPO roadshow, seeking to raise up to $64.4 billion by offering 825 million shares. This latest valuation stands at roughly $1.4 trillion, representing a drop from earlier estimations of $2 trillion. Notably, tech giants like Alphabet and Microsoft are set to invest $26 billion in a private placement.

event.title: TSMC to invest up to $1 billion in Anthropic, OpenAI
event.description: TSMC is set to invest up to $1 billion in the AI landscape, directing $500 million each to Anthropic and OpenAI. As Anthropic prepares for its IPO, this financial move by TSMC underscores its belief in a booming AI industry. With surging demand for AI chips, TSMC also aims to enhance its production capabilities, reinforcing its role in evolving AI infrastructure.

event.title: US consumer prices rise above expectations in October
event.description: Consumer prices in the US experienced a larger-than-expected increase in October, affecting future Federal Reserve interest rates. The Consumer Price Index rose by 0.4%, following a 0.6% increase in September. Core CPI also increased, leading many to predict a rate hike in December. Despite missing year-over-year data, inflation remains significantly above the Fed's 2% target.

event.title: Microsoft overtakes Nvidia in m-cap for first time since June '25, Nasdaq drops over 1%: Stock Market Live Updates
Nasdaq futures slip with Nvidia woes, Anthropic IPO in focus
event.description: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang is facing scrutiny, impacting investor sentiment in the tech sector. Anthropic is preparing for a huge initial public offering, potentially raising $64.4 billion. The market is anxious about upcoming inflation data that could influence stock performance. Cooling oil prices have provided some optimism among investors and pushed Dow futures higher. Concerns over the sustainability of the AI boom continue to linger in the background.

event.title: Anthropic's IPO: A close look at AI frontrunner's rapid growth, spiraling costs
event.description: Anthropic aims to raise up to $64.4 billion in an upcoming IPO, representing a significant market debut. The company plans a valuation of up to $1.02 trillion, showcasing its ambitions in AI. Founded by former OpenAI researchers, Anthropic's revenue has rapidly surged with enterprise adoption of its AI models. While facing substantial operating losses, the company remains committed to its substantial infrastructure investments.

event.title: US Treasury yields rise as Fed's Waller presses rate hike case
event.description: Following remarks from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller, short-dated Treasury yields saw an uptick, as he proposed the necessity of action despite seemingly moderated inflation data. Waller highlighted a possible half-point rate increase if inflation intensifies, signaling potential shifts in monetary policy. Economists expect a modest rise in core inflation, guiding market anticipations as money markets now fully reflect a 25 basis point increase in December.

event.title: Bajaj Finance issues 5.74 crore warrants to promoter for Rs 5,799 crore
event.description: Bajaj Finance has allotted 5.74 crore warrants to its promoter, Bajaj Finserv, for Rs 5,799 crore. The special committee of the board approved the issue at an issue price of Rs 1,010 per warrant. Each warrant is convertible into an equivalent number of equity shares of the company. A minimum of 25 percent of the consideration is payable at allotment, while the remaining 75 percent will be payable later.
